text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their second Summer Training Camp. Having 
quickly changed into her swimsuit, Smart 
Falcon is brimming with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately,
the moniker "Silence Suzuka of the 
Dirt" has caught on among the fans. She 
vowed to keep improving so she would
never bring shame to that name.
